result.summary: The layout is mostly intact. The main defect is that the 'Pizza' filter chip appears selected, yet the feed shows non-pizza restaurants. There is also a minor inconsistency in how the favorite buttons are styled.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is highlighted as the active filter, but the content below is not filtered. 'Fastest near you' shows a poké bowl, a burger place and a trattoria, and 'Popular right now' leads with Tokumaru Ramen Bar (tagged 'Ramen'). The selected state and the results contradict each other.
issues.suggestion: Make the selected chip filter the feed so only pizza restaurants appear. Alternatively, if no filter is applied on the home feed, default the selection to 'All'.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently. On the Tokumaru Ramen card, the heart's dark circular backdrop nearly disappears into the dark photo. On the pizza card below, the same button has a clearly visible dark circle.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent button container for all cards, such as a semi-transparent white or blurred circle. It should keep contrast regardless of the image behind it.
